text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(A searing fighting spirit. A tension so 
sharp it makes me tremble.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Haughty dreams, arrogant words. And yet, 
those eyes pursuing that dream are so 
innocent and pure.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Just by being on the turf. Just by 
dashing through it.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (The spotlight belongs to her—!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sheer, terrifying dominance shown by 
Orfevre at the Satsuki Sho spread in the 
blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, we lost, but... Still, that was 
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the Japan Derby. 
She'll definitely pull it off next time.

text_block_list.name: Umatter
text_block_list.text:
“I was watching from the stands, and 
Orfevre's aura was seriously built 
different. She didn't win this time, but 
purely on aura alone, it was a total 
landslide.”

text_block_list.name: Umatter
text_block_list.text:
"The Satsuki Sho was so fun! She lost,
but 
I'm so hyped for Orfevre's future now. 
Anyone wanna go to the Derby with me?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Amazing. Everyone is talking about 
"Orfevre"—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Ah... just as I thought. She's――)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Satsuki Sho. Before 
training began, she came to visit me with 
a formal demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um...
when we decided to head for the Aoba 
Sho, you said that even if we beat her,
we might lose out in terms of publicity, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, that became one of the 
reasons she set her sights on the Aoba
Sho 
as her goal race.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That hunch of mine was right after all. 
Actually, it went even beyond what I 
expected.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Her ability to fire up the crowdâher 
star quality is on a whole other level!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The sheer grandeur of her dream, and the 
sight of her striving to achieve it, 
captivated the eyes of everyone—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even in defeat, you find your eyes drawn 
to Orfevre before you know it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what kind of expression she's 
making right now. I wonder what she's 
feeling right now. I wonder how she'll 
take her next step forward."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really gets my heart racing, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Just winning won't cut it, I'll 
get eaten alive.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, that doesn't tell me what I'm 
actually supposed to do, though.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Do I just need to run a race they can
call 
unprecedented...? A race flashy enough to 
be talked about for years to come—is that 
what it takes?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Still, ah, either way, I can't do 
anything unless I win first...
choice_data_list: Then... what we should do right no...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right. Getting stronger 
is an absolute must."
choice_data_list: Then... what we need to do right n...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Build up enough strength to keep on 
winning, and challenge her. Then, maybe, 
eventually—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"If only I could see something...
I really 
hope that happens."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In any case, let's keep moving forward 
for now. And so, the days of training 
began once more."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah--

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...I already knew it,
but facing her like 
this really drives it home...
She truly is 
special...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...A natural-born star. A born, 
genius-level charisma.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...There's no way...
There's no way I can 
surpass something like that.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (..."Impossible"...?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...No, w-what am I thinking, idiot! 
Thinking so weakly won't get me 
anywhere—!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(If that's the case, then that's it! I'll 
let my feelings swell and scream them 
out...! Just like always!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, her speed plummeted. Did 
something go wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! Haah, haah! I-I'm sorry... Yelling a 
bit just now――

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Wait. Is it really okay for me to tell 
them?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Just now...
just as I was about to scream 
out my fear that it's impossible, all the 
strength drained from my body...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Is it okay for me to say that I 
thought it was impossible?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-I overthought what to shout a bit, 
and... I guess I kinda spun my wheels—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She wore a somewhat uncomfortable 
expression. Perhaps she didn't want to 
explain why.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate,
if she's dodging the question 
this much, it wouldn't be right to force 
it out of her. From the looks of it, she 
doesn't seem to be injured.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I felt a little lonely that she didn't 
open up to me, but... it can't be helped."
choice_data_list: (At least I should do my job prope...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to support her as best I can from 
my position as her Trainer."
choice_data_list: (The least I can do is stay on top...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next morning. Shifting my mindset, I 
decided to create a regimen that would 
benefit our future training and set 
meticulous goals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While running around trying to fine-tune 
the load through practical trial—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer-san...!? What's wrong?
You're 
sweating so much...
choice_data_list: I need it to make the training menu...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh? For making a menu?
choice_data_list: It's necessary for making the menu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod, hand over the work-in-progress 
menu, and point to where I want the 
numbers filled in.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...All that just to figure out some tiny 
numbers here...?
choice_data_list: I was thinking, if I'm ever going ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Let's grow step by step and grab victory 
in the Aoba Sho first." I told her that, 
wishing to offer some encouragement.
choice_data_list: I figured, if I'm ever going to be...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, umm...! It's just—I-I'm just so 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Right. Trainer is looking forward and 
giving it their absolute all.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...This is no time to whine about things 
being impossible.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(If anything...
if I want to move forward, 
I have to ignore my weakness and wipe it 
away!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! All right, I'm all fired up! Thank 
you so much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I want to be just like you, Trainer! I'm 
gonna work harder and harder, with 
everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, resetting our mindset,
our days of 
sprinting toward the Aoba Sho began.
